scene.placeText: the great terrace of the mosaic park on the hill above her world's Mediterranean capital in the golden morning — a long wavy bench clad in glittering broken-tile mosaic curling around the terrace's edge, columns like tree trunks holding up the stone, two whimsical gatehouses below, and the rippling palaces, mosaic rooftops and blue sea spread out beyond

This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the moon or a skyline unless the place below names them.
